title: Donkey Kong Bananza
description: Donkey Kong and Pauline smash, tunnel, and punch through a vast underground world using destructive strength and vocal powers.

title: Pokemon Pokopia
description: Players become a Ditto rebuilding a desolate world with Pokemon companions, blending Minecraft-style building with Animal Crossing-like life sim.

title: Mario Kart World
titleZh: 马力欧卡丁车 世界
description: Open-world reimagining of Mario Kart letting players race freely across an interconnected world with platforming elements like jumping and wall riding.

title: Yoshi and the Mysterious Book
description: Yoshi explores a magical storybook world emphasizing creature-interaction puzzles and experimentation over traditional platforming.

title: FAST Fusion
description: Spiritual successor to F-Zero featuring hypersonic antigravity racing at 60fps with fusion-based vehicle customization.

title: Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment
description: Musou-style action spinoff expanding on Tears of the Kingdom's Imprisoning War, with hordes of enemies and canon side stories.

title: Kirby Air Riders
titleZh: 星之卡比 飞行赛车
description: Sakurai-directed revival of Kirby Air Ride with racing, City Trial, and Top Ride modes built on deep physics-driven controls.

title: Mario Tennis Fever
titleZh: 马力欧网球 热力沸腾
description: Mario tennis title with 38 characters and 30 Fever Rackets, emphasizing chaotic multiplayer fun over its tutorial-like solo campaign.

title: Survival Kids
description: Cooperative four-player survival game where stranded kids navigate an island through teamwork and puzzle-solving.

title: Drag x Drive
description: 3v3 wheelchair basketball game using dual Joy-Con 2 motion controls to steer and shoot, showcasing Switch 2's mouse-style controls.

title: The Duskbloods
description: FromSoftware's Switch 2 exclusive multiplayer action RPG blending Gothic horror with PvPvE combat across shifting maps.

title: Splatoon Raiders
description: Switch 2 exclusive Splatoon spinoff where players join Deep Cut to raid the Spirhalite Islands against waves of Salmonids, solo or with up to three others.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
titleZh: 塞尔达传说 时光之笛
description: Switch 2 exclusive remake of the N64 classic featuring a new art style and voice acting, with no support announced for original Switch.

title: Orbitals
description: Kepler Interactive/Shapefarm's Switch 2 exclusive asymmetric co-op game with 80s anime visuals, casting two players as Maki and Omura aboard a collapsing space station.

title: Xenoblade Genesis
description: Monolith Soft's Switch 2 exclusive reinvention of the Xenoblade series with a high-fantasy aesthetic set inside a colossal inverted sphere world.

title: Ninjala 2: The Uncharted Planet
description: Switch 2 exclusive open-world sequel to Ninjala, the first chapter of a two-part saga with four-player local/online co-op against giant foes.

title: Pikuniku 2
description: Switch 2 exclusive sequel to the quirky physics-based adventure Pikuniku, now rendered in full 3D.

title: Pokemon Winds
description: Game Freak's Switch 2 exclusive open-world Pokemon entry set in a tropical archipelago region, releasing alongside its counterpart Pokemon Waves.

title: Pokemon Waves
description: Game Freak's Switch 2 exclusive open-world Pokemon entry with vast oceans and underwater areas, releasing alongside its counterpart Pokemon Winds.
